annotations.title: Is this artwork available now, and at what price (stock, auction, originals, collectibles)

description: Every way to buy ONE artwork right now, on every sales channel it sells: the physical objects first — a ready-made oil painting in stock ("Stock Discount Oil Painting", a real canvas that ships within 48 hours), an auction lot (current bid, minimum next bid, closing time), an original sold by its owner, a studio collectible — each with available_now, stock_quantity, price (fixed, shipping included) in your currency, size, buy_url and offer_text (one ready-to-paste line: give it to the customer as is, numbers and link untouched); then the made-to-order channels (hand-painted oil reproduction, art print: price by size through get_quotation) and the digital image licence. available_now is true only when the artwork ITSELF can be bought or bid on today; available_now_summary says it in one sentence. Call it whenever a customer asks whether something is available, in stock, ready to ship, discounted, on auction, or what it costs as a real object — and before any "yes, it is available". Identify the artwork by pk, or by title and/or artist_name (exact title first, then a surname-guarded search whose relevance comes back in "score"; a "warning" means check the returned title). Without pk or title, give channel to LIST the objects of that channel for sale now (cheapest first; optional artist_name, query words from the title, max_price in your currency, limit 1-10): "what do you have in stock under 200 euros?", "which auctions are open?". Prices follow the strict no-fallback currency rule of the quotation tools.

artist_name.description: Artist name: with title/pk it identifies the artwork; in the list mode it filters the objects by artist.

channel.description: List mode (no pk, no title): which physical channel to list — PaintingReady (ready-made oil paintings in stock), ProductAuction (auction lots), SellerProduct (originals sold by their owner), FactoryProduct (studio collectibles). With pk/title it narrows the offers to that channel.

language.description: Site language code (2 letters, e.g. "en", "fr"). Default "en".

max_price.description: List mode: highest price, in the given currency.

pk.description: Artwork pk (from a search tool or the page).

query.description: List mode: words from the title (e.g. "flowers", "sunset").

title.description: Artwork title (used when pk is not given).
